answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the delta log publishes the live set and the canyon audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 277 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Keeping 147 aliases alive therefore means 147 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the ivory quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
